title: Candidate record (CSV contract)
description: One row per candidate guide. Required: candidate_id + spacer_sequence (5'->3' DNA for Cas9/Cas12a, RNA U-notation for Cas13; orientation checked, never silently swapped; U auto-converted for DNA inputs and logged). Empty optional cells are omitted as columns, never left blank (NaN rejects at intake).

coding_consequence.description: exon/CDS/UTR placement + frame consequence from validated annotation

isoform_coverage.description: which validated transcripts the cut/edit site lies in

nicking_grna.description: prime editing PE3 only: nicking sgRNA spacer

editor.description: base/prime editing: editor or PE system used

donor_design.description: HDR only: ssODN/donor annotation (asymmetry class per Richardson 2016)
